name: Visual Quality
blurb: Aesthetic appeal and technical fidelity, computed per detected shot so that transition frames do not contaminate the score.

metrics.name: Aesthetic Score
metrics.text: Composition, lighting and colour, rated by Q-Align on each shot and aggregated over shots.

shots.description: In [Scene1], a static medium shot captures [entity1], the female street musician, facing the camera directly so her front face is clearly visible. She is passionately playing [entity2], the golden saxophone, on the busy sidewalk, her fingers moving nimbly over the keys. Blurred pedestrians walk behind her, establishing the bustling urban environment.

In [Scene1], the camera pans slightly to the right in a low-angle close-up shot, still keeping the front face of [entity1] in clear view. [entity1] continues playing [entity2] enthusiastically, swaying her shoulders slightly to the rhythm. The background shows the same brick buildings and green street sign from a lower perspective, confirming the single scene intersection.

entities.caption: A cheerful young female street musician with short blonde hair and a bright red beret. She is wearing a yellow sweater.
A shiny golden saxophone adorned with intricate engravings.

context.Setting: [Scene1]: A vibrant, bustling sidewalk in New York City with tall red brick buildings, a green street sign, and blurred pedestrians passing by in the background.
context.Lighting: [Scene1]: Bright natural daylight, casting soft dynamic shadows characteristic of a realistic urban daytime environment.
context.Atmosphere: [Scene1]: Energetic, metropolitan, and lively. Filled with the rhythmic and vibrant pulse of street life.

metrics.name: Perceptual Score
metrics.text: Technical artifacts and blur, rated by DeQA-Score on each shot and aggregated over shots.

shots.description: In [Scene1], a handheld high-angle medium-close-up captures [entity1], the green frog, resting on a damp leaf inside its glass terrarium. The camera slightly shakes as it observes the frog suddenly leaping forward to explore a nearby plant, with the open tent door serving as a visual anchor in the background.

In [Scene1], a tilted medium shot displays [entity2], the blue morpho butterfly, perched on the edge of a tall specimen jar. The camera slowly zooms in on the butterfly as it gracefully opens and closes its iridescent wings, with a microscope and the tent canvas visible in the blurred background.

entities.caption: A small brightly colored tree frog, about one inch long. Its skin is a brilliant emerald green with a fine, black reticulated pattern, featuring large, dark eyes and sticky toe pads.
A large blue morpho butterfly. Its wings are intensely iridescent blue on the top side with black margins and white spots, attached to a dark, slender body with long curled antennae.

context.Setting: [Scene1]: The interior of a biologist's field research tent in a dense, humid rainforest. The space is filled with scientific equipment: a wooden field desk, specimen jars, a microscope, a bright work lamp, and a glass terrarium.
context.Lighting: [Scene1]: Dappled sunlight filters through the tent's canvas, creating shifting patterns. The main light sources inside are a bright LED work lamp and a cool fluorescent lantern.
context.Atmosphere: [Scene1]: A mix of intense scientific focus and the immersive nature of the vibrant rainforest, highlighting close encounters with local wildlife.

name: Dynamic Quality
blurb: Whether the video contains meaningful motion, and whether that motion is physically credible.

metrics.name: Dynamic Degree
metrics.text: Subject and camera dynamics from DEVIL, calibrated against human motion ratings. Measured strictly inside shot intervals, so cuts and transitions are not counted as motion.

shots.description: The wobbly handheld camera uses a steep, tilted angle to frame the full bodies of [entity1] and [entity2] as they carefully navigate the uneven stone steps of [Scene1]. [entity1] leads with his broadsword raised as he looks upward, while [entity2] covers his flank with an arrow nocked. The dynamic tilt and shaky movement emphasize the treacherous nature of their quest.

From a towering bird's-eye-view, the camera slowly pans across the vast canyon floor of [Scene1], revealing the immense scale of the ancient ruins. Far below in this long shot, the tiny, full figures of [entity1] and [entity2] are seen approaching the glowing central dais. The sweeping aerial pan captures their isolation amidst the massive, crumbled statues and the glowing blue relic ahead.

entities.caption: A rugged human warrior with a scarred face, thick brown beard, wearing dented iron chainmail and a tattered crimson cloak, holding a heavy steel broadsword.
An agile elven scout with sharp facial features, pale skin, silver eyes, and pointed ears, wearing leaf-green leather armor and wielding an intricately carved wooden bow.

context.Setting: [Scene1] A treacherous, forgotten temple ruin carved into a steep, moss-covered canyon wall. Massive crumbled stone pillars, wrapped in glowing vines, surround a central raised dais where a crystalline relic rests.
context.Lighting: Dim, ethereal lighting with shafts of pale moonlight cutting through the canyon canopy, contrasting with the soft, pulsating bioluminescent blue glow of the relic.
context.Atmosphere: Tense, mysterious, and awe-inspiring, carrying the weight of ancient secrets and a perilous journey.

metrics.name: Physical Plausibility
metrics.text: A VLM judge (Qwen3.8) looks for physical anomalies: unnatural anatomical deformation, objects that vanish, implausible interactions.

shots.description: In [Scene1], a high-angle, medium-long shot with slight handheld motion looks down at [entity1] on the teal court, capturing her from the knees up. After scoring a crucial point, she suddenly turns and pumps her fist in a powerful celebration, her joyful face tilted upward towards the camera.

In [Scene2], a tilted, full shot with a dramatic Dutch angle dollies past the cheering audience in the stands, focusing on [entity2] at the front row. [entity1] runs to the edge of the stands and high-fives [entity2]. He is seen clapping and cheering enthusiastically in response to the athlete's successful play, surrounded by other fans in the background.

entities.caption: A female athlete in her 20s with blonde hair tied back in a neat ponytail. She is wearing a yellow national team jersey with the number 7 printed on it.
A passionate male fan in his 30s wearing a green baseball cap and a white t-shirt.

context.Setting: [Scene1]: A professional indoor sports arena with a vibrant, teal-colored court and distinct white line markings. [Scene2]: The spectator stands of the arena, filled with an enthusiastic crowd.
context.Lighting: [Scene1]: Bright, uniform overhead stadium lighting that fully illuminates the court, eliminating any harsh shadows. [Scene2]: The same bright overhead lighting extends to the stands, creating a clear, energetic view of the audience.
context.Atmosphere: [Scene1]: High-energy and intensely competitive, charged with the peak emotion of a professional game. [Scene2]: Electric and celebratory, filled with the collective roar and excitement of passionate fans.

name: Semantic Alignment
blurb: How faithfully the video realises the structured script: events, transition style, cut timing and camera language.

metrics.name: VQA-Score
metrics.text: Binary questions probe whether scripted events occur. Each question is tied to its target shot, and full credit is given only when the event appears in the intended shot.

shots.description: In [Scene1], the camera slowly pans across the snowy, festive outdoor market to reveal [entity1] standing majestically in the center. Fresh snow rests on its illuminated branches, contrasting with the dark winter sky above.

In [Scene2], the camera remains static, capturing a detailed close-up of [entity2] hanging from a rustic wooden mantelpiece. The thick woolen textures are highlighted by the gentle, dancing flames from the fireplace directly behind them.

entities.caption: A giant evergreen Christmas tree adorned with densely packed warm white fairy lights, glossy red baubles, and a large golden star tree topper.
Three thick, hand-knitted red and green wool stockings featuring intricate white reindeer patterns and fluffy white cuffs.

context.Setting: [Scene1]: A traditional European outdoor Christmas market with rustic wooden stalls covered in fresh white snow. [Scene2]: A cozy domestic living room with dark oak wood floors, a brick fireplace, and scattered wrapped gift boxes.
context.Lighting: [Scene1]: Cool ambient night light contrasted by the warm, festive glow of countless string lights hanging across the market. [Scene2]: Warm, flickering orange firelight combined with soft, dim room lighting that creates an intimate, comforting space.
context.Atmosphere: [Scene1]: Joyful, bustling, and magical, capturing the communal spirit of a winter holiday. [Scene2]: Peaceful, intimate, and nostalgic, reflecting the warmth of family traditions.

metrics.name: Transition Control & Cut Timing
metrics.text: TC checks that each requested transition occurs (TC-V) and has the requested type (TC-A): hard cut, dissolve, fade or wipe, detected by OmniShotCut and TransVLM with Qwen3.8 resolving ambiguous cases. CTA measures, in seconds, how closely the generated boundaries follow the requested timeline.

shots.description: In [Scene1], an eye-level, medium-long shot pans slowly across the stylized ocean. The frame captures the dynamic, claw-like crests of the deep blue and white crashing waves, rendered with bold linework typical of ukiyo-e prints. The flat, gradient sky serves as a calm backdrop to the turbulent water.

In [Scene1], a static, low-angle, close-up shot focuses entirely on the snow-capped peak of Mount Fuji and the stylized red sun beside it. The mountain features strong, symmetrical black outlines and a pristine white peak, contrasting sharply with the vivid red circle of the sun and the pale yellow sky. The composition emphasizes the flat, graphic nature of the woodblock print style without including the waves.

context.Setting: [Scene1]: A breathtaking landscape rendered in a traditional Japanese ukiyo-e woodblock print style, featuring flat, vibrant colors and bold black outlines. The scene includes a majestic, snow-capped Mount Fuji in the distance, framed by stylized, crashing ocean waves with claw-like crests in the foreground, and gnarled pine trees on a rocky shore to the side.
context.Lighting: [Scene1]: Even, flat lighting characteristic of woodblock prints, with no realistic shadows. A stylized red sun provides a vivid color contrast against a gradient sky of pale yellow and soft blue.
context.Atmosphere: [Scene1]: Serene yet dynamic, capturing the dramatic tension of nature with a timeless, artistic elegance.

metrics.name: Camera Control
metrics.text: For every matched shot, FilmOps operators predict shot scale, camera angle and camera movement, which are compared with the script.

shots.description: In [Scene1], an eye-level medium shot dollies alongside [entity1] as he serves the ball with a rapid spin. [entity1]'s face is clearly visible, his eyes locked onto the ball with sharp focus. [entity2], whose face is clearly visible, stands ready on the opposite side of the table in the background.

In [Scene1], an eye-level medium tracking shot follows [entity2], whose face is clearly visible, aggressively smashing the ball back, while [entity1] lunges forward to defend the shot. Even during this rapid movement, [entity1]'s face is clearly visible, displaying a fierce and determined expression.

entities.caption: A young male table tennis player with short black hair, wearing a red sports jersey and black shorts.
A young male table tennis player with blonde hair, wearing a blue sports polo and white shorts.

context.Setting: [Scene1]: A professional indoor table tennis arena, featuring a blue table with a white net at the center, surrounded by dark red flooring and blurred spectator stands.
context.Lighting: [Scene1]: Bright overhead stadium lights illuminating the table evenly without harsh shadows.
context.Atmosphere: [Scene1]: Highly energetic and focused, conveying the intense competitive spirit of a championship match.

name: Cross-Shot Consistency
blurb: Whether entities, backgrounds and faces survive the cut. Each sub-metric is computed only on scripts annotated with the corresponding relation, and reported as a validity rate (-V) plus a conditional score (-S).

metrics.name: Entity Consistency
metrics.text: Qwen3.8 locates the recurring entities across shots and rates whether shape, proportions, colour, materials and clothing stay consistent. Changes explained by viewpoint, pose or the script are not penalised.

shots.description: In [Scene1], the camera captures a medium-close-up with a tilted angle, creating a slightly off-kilter perspective. It slowly zooms in on [entity1], her face clearly visible and softly illuminated by the glowing table lamp nearby. She is smiling, leaning forward slightly, and gently patting the shoulder of [entity2], whose smiling side profile is also clearly visible next to her.

In [Scene1], the camera transitions to a high-angle looking down at the beige sofa in a medium-long shot, capturing both women from the knees up. The camera dollys forward slightly over them. [entity1] and [entity2] are sitting side-by-side, with the lit table lamp clearly visible at the edge of the frame acting as a spatial anchor. Both of their faces are clearly visible as they interact. [entity2] holds up a blue smartphone, showing the illuminated screen to [entity1]. They both look down at the screen with focused expressions, as [entity1] slightly raises her eyebrows in surprise and [entity2] smirks.

entities.caption: A woman with glasses, wearing a dark blue suit jacket over a white shirt, with a small gold badge pinned on her left chest.
A woman with long hair, wearing a beige trench coat, with red nail polish on her fingers.

context.Setting: [Scene1]: An intimate and warmly lit living room at night. The room is furnished with a comfortable beige sofa, and in the background, there are window blinds revealing the night outside, a lit table lamp, and decorative candlesticks.
context.Lighting: [Scene1]: Soft, warm light primarily from a table lamp on one side, creating a gentle contrast between warm yellows and deep blues in the shadows. Accents of gold from decorative items add to the warmth.
context.Atmosphere: [Scene1]: Cozy, private, and intimate, fostering a sense of close friendship and shared secrets.

metrics.name: Background Consistency
metrics.text: Only shots that the script assigns to the same scene are compared, for continuity of spatial layout, fixed structures and textures.

shots.description: In [Scene1], a bird's-eye-view full shot captures [entity1] from directly above as she looks up. The camera dollies smoothly forward, showing her entire figure sitting in the plush red seat near the traditional floral arrangements, clapping her hands enthusiastically and laughing, her face clearly visible.

In [Scene1], the camera views the theater from a tilted angle in a medium-long shot. It slowly tilts upwards, revealing the same plush red seats and floral arrangements as a visual anchor, framing [entity1] from the knees up in the front row. She is clapping, smiling and looking towards an unseen stage, with her face clearly visible.

entities.caption: A woman in her 30s with dark, shoulder-length hair. She is wearing a bright red sweater.

context.Setting: [Scene1]: A grand, festively decorated theater during a Chinese New Year celebration. The hall is filled with rows of plush red seats, and the stage area is adorned with traditional floral arrangements, primarily in red and gold.
context.Lighting: [Scene1]: Bright and warm stage lighting illuminates the audience, creating a vibrant and largely shadow-free environment that highlights the joyful expressions of the crowd.
context.Atmosphere: [Scene1]: Exuberant and celebratory. There is a strong sense of communal joy and festive excitement, characteristic of a major cultural holiday.

metrics.name: Face Consistency
metrics.text: InsightFace detects faces in every shot, Qwen3.8 picks the target person, and identity features are compared across shots with calibrated nearest-neighbour similarity.

shots.description: In [Scene1], a static medium shot shows two friends, [entity1] and [entity2], interacting at a cafe table. [entity1] is laughing and gesturing with her hands while telling a story, and [entity2] leans forward, listening intently with a warm smile.

In [Scene1], a high-angle close-up focuses on the table surface. [entity2] playfully reaches for [entity1]'s pastry with his fork, and [entity1] mock-defends her plate with her hand, both smiling brightly.

In [Scene1], a static close-up focuses on their faces. [entity1] takes a sip from her coffee cup while looking at [entity2], who is now animatedly talking and gesturing, completing the lively atmosphere.

entities.caption: A young woman with blonde hair, wearing a casual t-shirt, sitting at a cafe table.
A young man with short brown hair, wearing a plaid shirt, sitting opposite the blonde woman.

context.Lighting: [Scene1]: Bright, diffused natural daylight illuminating the interior, creating a clean, airy, and inviting look.
